about: Native-only text substitutions for the pinned YR tree (vendor/ra2-decomp, vendor/tibsun headers; lane Y1), applied by yr/tools/yr_units.py before the port rewrites, where clang rejects VC6 dialect. 'file' is a path under the tree's header directory ('hdr/<name>') or its sources ('src/<path>'), or '*' for every file; 'old' is literal text (every occurrence; a fixup that matches nothing fails the generation), or with 'regex': true a Python regular expression. Each keeps the original behaviour; 'why' says how. Like port/fixups.json for the RA2 tree, it never edits yr/. A row with 'cut' instead of 'old' removes the function whose marker (// FUNCTION: GAMEMD <address>) it names, up to the next marker or the end of the file; yr/glue supplies the native version. A row with 'skip_unit' leaves that source out of the native build (its functions are link-closure traps until yr/glue or a later stage supplies them).
